newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Network slumps on earnings downgrade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Network slumps on earnings downgrade.

text.p: Shares in newly-listed video producer and distributor Network Entertainment Ltd slumped 24.5 cents to A$1.00 on Friday after it downgraded its earnings estimate for the full year on weaker than expected sales.
Network Entertainment Group Ltd said on Friday it was unlikely to meet forecast prospectus earnings before interest tax and abnormals for the year to June 30, due to weaker than expected sales.
Network forecast in its prospectus a net profit in 1996/97 of A$2.67 million, up from A$1.31 million in 1995/96.
Network Entertainment was owned by multimedia company Shomega Ltd which was acquired by publishing group Pacific Magazines and Publishing Ltd earlier this year.
It debuted in early December at A$2.15 and has been falling since then.
The company issued six million shares to raise a total of A$12 million at A$2.00 a share late last year. This represented 35 percent of the company's issued capital.
The remaining 65 percent of the company is owned by its senior management and associates.
